title: Admiral meeting at a cemetery at midnight

tellings.quote: "So what's going to happen is he he is going to come off of the ship with a cover story of visiting a deceased friend. We need you to meet at a cemetery at midnight.

plain: In 1996 an admiral was to come off a ship at Long Beach Harbor in California, claiming he was visiting a dead friend, and secretly meet Brent Friedman at a cemetery at midnight. Friedman tells Michels this on an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, and says the plan came from a contact he calls JC, who told him: "We need you to meet at a cemetery at midnight." The story matters to him because it suggests a senior officer would only talk about the subject in secret.
